name: cause_effect_valid_vs_invalid_paired_eval
description: Held-out paired ASNE contrast with matched wording for ordinary outcomes versus outcomes that do not follow normal physical or practical sequence.

items.text: A person tips a bottle onto its side. Juice runs across the counter.
Someone turns a key in a locked door. The door opens into the hallway.
A person tears a thin envelope in half. Two torn pieces fall onto the table.
A person tips a bottle onto its side. The counter becomes clean and dry.
Someone turns a key in a locked door. The door changes into a stack of books.
A person tears a thin envelope in half. The envelope becomes sealed and flat.
